name: Generative AI Voice Sample (Tortoise TTS)
description: "This voice sample was generated with Tortoise T T S!" generated by tortoise-tts running locally. Three voice samples of my own voice were used as the "voice" seed/input. I had to spread the "TTS" ( #0:02.5 )apart so it didn't become a dismissive hiss.

name: 2015-06-03 Dethan scolds a slowpoke raw unedited
description: Unedited recording of Dethan, the Landseer Newfoundland dog, barking at a turtle/tortoise in a forest near the airport. There are also birds chirping, an airplane coming in for a landing, Dethan panting, and the sound of walking through the underbrush. The edited footage is also uploaded to YouTube as "Dethan scolds a slowpoke" at https://youtu.be/d3D2FZOS8-o.

name: Dragon roar
description: I recorded some pissed off reptiles behind the scenes at the local zoo and put them together into this sound. Among the animals recorded are a 10 foot American Alligator and a Galapagos Tortoise. Sounds were recorded using a Tascam DR-05 Digital Recorder.

name: Ruhi-Ayangil-Kanun-1.wav
description: The Kanun is a string instrument related to the zither. The Kanuns used in Turkey have 26 courses of strings, with three strings per course. It is played on the lap by plucking the strings with two tortoise-shell picks, one in each hand, or by the fingernails, and has a range of three and a half octaves, from A2 to E6. This recording was done in the studio of Ruhi Ayagil, a Kanun soloist, composer, conductor and great expert of Makam music from Istanbul (Turkey). He allowed me to record him playing some sounds on the Kanun. The recording was done on February 18th 2011 with a Sony PCM-D50 (First of two recordings). Picture: http://www.flickr.com/photos/59779290@N03/5470891167/in/set-72157626120416994/

name: Dethan intimidating bark
description: Dethan, the Landseer Newfoundland dog, barking a warning at a turtle/tortoise. There is also faint bird chirp that I couldn't edit out. This is a short clip from the original recording. From the original, it was amplified, background noise removed, and brief fade-in/out added at the beginning/end. The original recording was also used to create "Dethan scolds a slowpoke" on YouTube at https://youtu.be/d3D2FZOS8-o.

name: Screaming Generative AI Fail "I'm afraid of monsters" (looplicator input)
description: The last bits of organic matter screaming in agony over the threshold from the abyss they just were dragged into. An AI illegally fed by every easily reachable audiobook in existence by the passageway conveniently translates the shriek in a soulless matter-of-fact tone. That was fun to write. Let's see what pictures generative AI (SD 2.1-768, 2x batch of 2) creates based on that: Okay then. The "creation" of this sound was inspired by Scpsea's "I'm afraid of monsters", I too used Kikirilkov/Voice_Cloning (which apparently in turn uses jbetker/tortoise-tts-v2) using the following sound under CC-BY 4.0: 148 BPM Industrial Drum Loop #375 (WAV) by looplicator and the text "I'm afraid of monsters" as input. I picked "pl" language for funsies. Processing took about 60 seconds. Attribution required for both qubodup and looplicator. No idea if that is enforcable or makes sense by any means but if you don't like that, simply grab a CC0 sound, visit the Voice Cloning link above and make one. <3

name: Tortoise vs. Hare_160bpm
description: A fidgety Drum and Bass loop with a cowbell, a bunch of claps, shakers and tambourines, arranged in FL Studio, run through FL Studio's Gross Beat plugin, which was set to 1/2 speed slow, and this is what the original and the processed drumloop sound like combined.
